guidance.sentence: • For full year 2026, Protolabs is raising its guidance and now expects revenue growth between 10% and 11%.
• For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue between $143.0 million and $151.0 million.

• For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects GAAP diluted net income per share between $0.28 and $0.36, and non-GAAP diluted net income per share between $0.46 and $0.54. See "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below.

• For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects GAAP diluted net income per share between $0.28 and $0.36, and non-GAAP diluted net income per share between $0.46 and $0.54. See "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below.

summary: Protolabs raised its full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to 10%-11% (from 8%-10%) and expects Q4 2026 revenue of $143.0-$151.0 million, with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.28-$0.36 and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.46-$0.54.
